locator: art. 9 (εἰς μίαν, ἁγίαν, καθολικὴν καὶ ἀποστολικὴν ἐκκλησίαν)
interpretation: The creed professes this clause as an article of faith. The claim records what the creed asserts, read from the Greek division of the pinned witness; it does not claim the article is true, which the skeleton derives only from open premises. The article professes belief in that Church; it does not itself identify it with any present society, so it is not identified with stage 6.
